security_audit.summary: The audit confirms that the skill requires LINEAR_API_KEY access and may read it from a .env file. The Bun commands are expected for this CLI skill, while several markdown backtick findings are false positives. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Document least-privilege Linear token use and avoid printing tokens. Prefer secure environment storage over shared .env files.
Limit .env loading to LINEAR_API_KEY only. Never enumerate, transmit, or log other environment variables.
Publish the referenced command source or checksums so users can inspect the script before running it.

content.user_title: List Linear Milestones from the CLI
content.value_statement: Teams need quick visibility into Linear milestones without opening the web app. This skill runs a read-only CLI workflow to list project milestones.
actual_capabilities: Lists Linear project milestones through a Bun-based CLI command.
Filters milestones by project name with partial case-insensitive matching.
Lists milestones across all projects when requested.
Limits result counts with a command option.
Can return JSON output for downstream processing.
limitations: Requires the Bun runtime to be installed before use.
Requires a valid LINEAR_API_KEY in the environment or .env file.
Provides read-only milestone listing and does not update Linear data.
Depends on Linear API availability and the permissions of the configured key.

use_cases.title: Review project milestones
use_cases.description: List milestones for one Linear project before a planning or status meeting.

use_cases.title: Scan portfolio timelines
use_cases.description: List milestones across all projects with a small result limit for quick review.

use_cases.title: Prepare milestone reports
use_cases.description: Request JSON output so another approved tool can process milestone data.

prompt_templates.title: Show one project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to list milestones for the Linear project named Mount Vernon. Show the terminal output directly.

prompt_templates.title: Limit all projects
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to list milestones across all Linear projects, limited to ten results.

prompt_templates.title: Get structured output
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to list milestones for the Monticello project with JSON output for later analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze after listing
prompt_templates.prompt: List milestones across all projects, then summarize visible schedule patterns. Do not expose or print API keys.

output_examples.input: Show milestones for the Mount Vernon project.
output_examples.output: A terminal table lists matching milestone names, project names, target dates, and statuses. The assistant leaves the table unchanged unless asked.

output_examples.input: List ten milestones across all projects.
output: The CLI returns up to ten milestones from available Linear projects.
The result is displayed directly in the terminal for review.

output_examples.input: Get structured milestone output for Monticello.
output_examples.output: The command returns structured milestone data that another approved tool can parse or filter.

best_practices: Use a Linear API key with the minimum access needed to read milestones.
Keep the key in a secure environment manager when possible.
Ask for JSON output only when another tool must process the results.
anti_patterns: Do not paste Linear API keys into chat prompts or command arguments.
Do not run the skill in untrusted repositories without checking bundled scripts.
Do not ask it to update projects or milestones because it is read-only.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It lists Linear project milestones from the command line using a read-only workflow.

faq.question: Does it modify Linear data?
faq.answer: No. The documented commands only list milestones and do not update projects or milestones.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: It requires LINEAR_API_KEY in the environment or a .env file that the command can read.

faq.question: Can it filter by project?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports project name filtering with partial case-insensitive matching.

faq.question: Does it require Bun?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documentation requires the Bun runtime before running the CLI command.

faq.question: Can the output support automation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can request JSON output, but credentials should never appear in the results.
